spec.expr:
sum(increase(loki_distributor_bytes_received_total[24h])) / 1024^3 

# loki_distributor_bytes_received_total → Total bytes received by Loki distributors
# increase(...[24h])                    → Calculates total bytes ingested over last 24 hours
# /1024^3                               → Converts bytes to GiB
# Final output                          → Total log data ingested in last 24h (GiB)

spec.description: Total volume of logs ingested by the Loki distributor over the last 24 hours. This represents the raw incoming log data before compression and storage.
spec.title: Daily Log Ingestion (GB)

spec.expr:
sum(increase(tempo_distributor_bytes_received_total[30d])) / 1024/1024/1024

# tempo_distributor_bytes_received_total → Total bytes received by Tempo distributors
# increase(...[30d])                    → Calculates total increase over last 30 days
# /1024^3                               → Converts bytes to GiB
# Final output                          → Total trace data ingested in last 30 days (GiB)

spec.description: Total volume of trace data ingested by Tempo over the past 30 days (in GB).
spec.title: Total Ingestion (Last 30 Days)

spec.expr:
sum(increase(tempo_ingester_flush_size_bytes_sum[30d])) / 1024^3

# tempo_ingester_flush_size_bytes_sum → Total bytes flushed by Tempo ingesters
# increase(...[30d])                  → Calculates total increase over last 30 days
# /1024^3                             → Converts bytes to GiB
# Final output                        → Total trace data flushed/stored in last 30 days (GiB)

spec.description: Total volume of trace data flushed and persisted to backend storage by Grafana Tempo ingesters over the last 30 days (in GB).
spec.title: Trace Data Flushed to Storage (Last 30 Days)

spec.expr:
(
  sum(increase(tempo_ingester_flush_size_bytes_sum[30d]))
/
  sum(increase(tempo_distributor_bytes_received_total[30d]))
) * 100

# Calculates Tempo storage efficiency by comparing
# flushed/stored trace data with incoming trace data.

# Formula:
# (stored trace data / received trace data) * 100

# Metrics Used:
# - tempo_ingester_flush_size_bytes_sum:
#   Total bytes flushed/stored by Tempo ingesters
#
# - tempo_distributor_bytes_received_total:
#   Total bytes received by Tempo distributors

# Interpretation:
# - Lower %  → Better compression/storage efficiency
# - Higher % → More storage consumed

# Final output:
# Percentage of received trace data stored over last 30 days

spec.description: Shows how efficiently Tempo compresses trace data before storing it in object storage. It is calculated as the ratio of flushed (stored) data to incoming trace data over a defined time window
spec.title: Compression (%)

spec.description: Displays the trend of trace data ingestion over time.
spec.title: Ingestion Trend

spec.expr:
sum(increase(vm_rows_inserted_total[1d])) * 16 / 1024^3

# Multiplied by 16 to estimate storage size assuming 1 sample ≈ 16 bytes.

sum(increase(vm_rows_inserted_total[30d])) * 16 / 1024^3

# vm_rows_inserted_total → Total metric samples inserted into VictoriaMetrics
# increase(...[30d])     → Calculates total samples inserted over last 30 days
# * 16                   → Assumes 1 sample ≈ 16 bytes (estimated storage size)
# /1024^3                → Converts bytes to GiB
# Final output           → Estimated metric data ingested in last 30 days (GiB)

spec.description: Estimated total volume of metric data ingested over the last 30 days (in GB), based on sample count approximation.
spec.title: Total Metrics Ingestion (Last 30 Days, GB)

spec.expr:
sum(vm_data_size_bytes) / 1024^3

# vm_data_size_bytes → Total storage size used by VictoriaMetrics data
# /1024^3            → Converts bytes to GiB
# Final output       → Current VictoriaMetrics data storage usage (GiB)

(
  sum(vm_data_size_bytes)
/
  (sum(vm_rows_inserted_total) * 16)
) * 100

# Calculates VictoriaMetrics storage efficiency by comparing
# actual stored data size with estimated raw ingested data size.

# Formula:
# (stored data size / estimated ingested data size) * 100

# Metrics Used:
# - vm_data_size_bytes:
#   Current storage used by VictoriaMetrics
#
# - vm_rows_inserted_total:
#   Total metric samples inserted
#
# - * 16:
#   Assumes 1 sample ≈ 16 bytes (estimated raw sample size)

# Interpretation:
# - Lower %  → Better compression/storage efficiency
# - Higher % → More storage consumed

# Final output:
# Percentage of estimated ingested metric data currently stored

spec.description: Estimated compression efficiency of stored metric data compared to raw samples
spec.title: Compression (%)

spec.description: Shows the rate at which metric samples are being ingested into VictoriaMetrics over time.
spec.title: Sample Rate Trend

spec.expr:
sum(increase(loki_ingester_chunk_stored_bytes_total[30d])) / 1024^3

# loki_ingester_chunk_stored_bytes_total → Total chunk data stored by Loki ingesters
# increase(...[30d])                     → Calculates total chunk data written over last 30 days
# /1024^3                                → Converts bytes to GiB
# Final output                           → Total Loki chunk data stored in last 30 days (GiB)

spec.description: Total volume of log data written as compressed chunks by Grafana Loki ingesters over the last 30 days.
spec.title: Ingester Chunk Storage (Last 30 Days, GB)

spec.expr:
sum(increase(loki_distributor_bytes_received_total[30d])) / 1024^3

# loki_distributor_bytes_received_total → Total bytes received by Loki distributors
# increase(...[30d])                    → Calculates total bytes ingested over last 30 days
# /1024^3                               → Converts bytes to GiB
# Final output                          → Total log data ingested in last 30 days (GiB)

spec.description: Total volume of logs ingested across all Grafana Loki distributor instances over the last 30 days. Represents raw incoming log data before compression and storage.
spec.title: Total Ingestion (Last 30 Days, GB)

spec.expr:
(
  sum(rate(loki_ingester_chunk_stored_bytes_total[1h]))
/
  sum(rate(loki_distributor_bytes_received_total[1h]))
) * 100

#Formula:
#(stored data / incoming raw data) * 100

#interpretation:
#- Lower % → better compression (less storage used)
#- Higher % → less efficient compression

spec.description: Percentage of incoming log data stored after compression over time. Lower values indicate better compression efficiency in Grafana Loki.
spec.title: Compression (%)

spec.description: Displays the rate at which log data is being written to storage by Loki ingesters over time.
spec.title: Loki Ingestion Trend

spec.expr:
sum(increase(tempo_distributor_bytes_received_total[1d])) / 1024/1024/1024 

# tempo_distributor_bytes_received_total → Total bytes received by Tempo distributors
# increase(...[1d])                     → Calculates total increase over last 24h
# /1024^3                               → Converts bytes to GiB
# Final output                          → Total trace data ingested in last 24h (GiB)

spec.description: Total volume of trace data ingested by Grafana Tempo over the last 24 hours.
spec.title: Daily Trace Ingestion (GB)
